description: The 10 texts of the S4.2 engine benchmark (SPEECH_QUALITY_PLAN.md S4.2a/S4.2b). Output file i of an engine is the rendering of texts[i]. skip_wer marks a text with no single spoken form, so an ASR transcript cannot be matched to it.

texts.text: I can't believe you did that!
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
Please call me back at your earliest convenience, because the meeting has been moved to three o'clock.
Wait... what did you just say? I did not hear you properly!
The committee reviewed the proposal carefully and decided to postpone the final vote until next month, pending further analysis of the budget.
Dr. Smith arrived at 10:30 a.m. and left before noon.
Stop! Do not move. Put your hands where I can see them.
Once upon a time, in a small village by the sea, there lived an old fisherman and his wife.
